title: Chapter 31 — Queen Mab
paragraphs: The next morning, Stubb approached Flask.

"What a strange dream, King-Post, I never had anything like it. You know the old man's ivory leg? Well, I dreamed he kicked me with it. And when I tried to kick back, upon my soul, little man, I kicked my own leg right off! And then, suddenly, Ahab turned into a pyramid, and I, like a complete fool, kept kicking at it. But here's what was even stranger, Flask — you know how strange dreams are — through all that rage, I somehow kept thinking to myself that, after all, Ahab's kick wasn't really much of an insult. 'Why,' I thought, 'what's the fuss? It's not a real leg, only a false one.' And there's a huge difference between a kick from a living leg and one from a dead leg. That's what makes a blow from a hand, Flask, fifty times worse than a blow from a cane. It's the living limb that makes the living insult, little man. And the whole time, mind you — while I was stubbing my stupid toes against that cursed pyramid — so ridiculously contradictory was it all — the whole time, I was thinking, 'What's his leg now but a cane — a whalebone cane? Yes,' I thought, 'it was just a playful beating — really just a whaleboning he gave me — not a vulgar kick. Besides,' I thought, 'look at it: the end of it — the foot part — what a tiny point it is. Whereas if a broad-footed farmer kicked me, now there's a great broad insult. But this insult is whittled down to a mere point.' But now comes the best part of the dream, Flask. While I was battering away at the pyramid, a sort of badger-haired old merman with a hump on his back grabs me by the shoulders and spins me around. 'What are you doing?' says he. Lord! I was scared. What a face! But somehow the next moment I was over the fright. 'What am I doing?' says I at last. 'And what business is that of yours, Mr. Humpback? Do you want a kick?' By the lord, Flask, I had no sooner said that than he turned his backside to me, bent over, and pulled up a bunch of seaweed he was wearing — and what do you think I saw? Thunder alive, man, his rear was stuck full of marlinspikes, with the points sticking out! Says I, on second thought, 'I guess I won't kick you, old fellow.' 'Wise Stubb,' said he, 'wise Stubb.' And he kept muttering it, sort of chewing his own gums like an old hag. Seeing he wasn't going to stop with his 'wise Stubb, wise Stubb,' I figured I might as well go back to kicking the pyramid. But I'd barely lifted my foot when he roared, 'Stop that kicking!' 'What now, old fellow?' says I. 'Look here,' says he, 'let's think about this insult. Captain Ahab kicked you, didn't he?' 'Yes, he did,' says I — 'right here.' 'Very good,' says he. 'He used his ivory leg, didn't he?' 'Yes, he did,' says I. 'Well then,' says he, 'wise Stubb, what do you have to complain about? Didn't he kick with real force? It wasn't a common pine leg he kicked with, was it? No, you were kicked by a great man, and with a beautiful ivory leg, Stubb. It's an honor. I consider it an honor. Listen, wise Stubb. In old England the greatest lords consider it a great glory to be slapped by a queen and made knights of the garter. But let it be your boast, Stubb, that you were kicked by old Ahab and made a wise man of. Remember what I say: accept his kicks as honors, and on no account kick back — for you can't help yourself, wise Stubb. Don't you see that pyramid?' With that, he suddenly seemed to swim off into the air. I snored, rolled over — and there I was in my hammock! Now, what do you think of that dream, Flask?"
"I don't know. Seems kind of silly to me, though."

"Maybe. Maybe. But it's made a wise man of me, Flask. Do you see Ahab standing there, looking sideways over the stern? Well, the best thing you can do, Flask, is leave the old man alone. Never speak to him, no matter what he says. Wait! What's that he's shouting? Listen!"
"Masthead, there! Look sharp, all of you! There are whales around here!"
"If you see a white one, scream your lungs out for him!"

"What do you think of that, Flask? Isn't there something a little strange about it? A white whale — did you catch that? Look here — there's something special going on. Be ready for it, Flask. Ahab has something bloody on his mind. But shh — he's coming this way."
